_note: CMP-03 Selects & dropdowns + CMP-07 Tabs & Tooltips. Page '02 — Components', section 'CMP-03/07 Selects, menus, tabs & tooltips' (13:473) at X=12500,Y=0. Use I(id, {variant}, {prop: value}). Override per-instance text by finding TEXT layers by name (Label, Name, Standard, Fee, Status, Term, Definition).

Select/Field.note: 320px. Value not bound in Error (placeholder). Pair Open with Menu/Panel 8px below.

Menu/Item.note: 256px fixed; set layoutSizingHorizontal=FILL inside panels. Override TEXT layer 'Label'. After swapping Icon, re-tint the icon (icon/muted).

Menu/Section Label.note: Overline group heading, e.g. SORT BY / LANGUAGE / REGION

Menu/Panel.note: Generic dropdown: Sort by + Actions + destructive. surface/overlay, border/subtle, radius 14, Elevation/3

Select/Network Option.note: 468px row. TEXT layers: Name, Standard, Fee, Status; ellipse 'Status dot'. Chain swap takes CHAINS[...] ids.

Select/Network.note: 480px. Open lists BNB/Polygon/Arbitrum(selected)/Ethereum(Congested)/Solana with fees + wrong-network warning

Select/Token.note: 480px. USDT only; Open shows contract details for selected network (Arbitrum One, DEMO contract)

Select/Multi.note: 400px. Chips in field, search, Select all / Clear, checkbox list, Cancel + Apply (3)

Menu/Filter Chip.note: 32px pill; Icon accepts chain marks or 16px icons

Menu/Filter.note: 360px filter popover: Status / Network / Type / Date range, active count 3 (Badge/Count recoloured brand), Reset + Apply filters

Menu/User.note: 300px: avatar + @nova.k + GP-48213 + VIP Gold; Available 9,215.30 USDT + breakdown bar (DEMO); Dashboard, Wallet, Security, Responsible gaming, Settings, Log out

Menu/Language & Region.note: 300px: 8 languages (English selected) + region Portugal Permitted (read-only, lock) + detection note

Tabs/Underline.note: Nested Badge/Count layer 'Count' — set its Count prop on the nested instance

Tabs/Underline Bar.note: 720px composed bar (Overview active, My entries 35, Winners, Fairness (VRF), Rules, Refunds disabled) + baseline

Tabs/Pill Bar.note: Game lobby: All games (active), Roulette, Crash, Dice, Coinflip, Blackjack

Tooltip.note: Text bound in Info only; Term + Definition in Definition only. Arrow 16x8, centred.

Tooltip/Balance Glossary.note: 380px popover: Available/Locked/Pending/Owed with balance colours, icons, definitions, amounts reconciling to 12,480.50 (DEMO)
